<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Thai:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: alternating navy and white bands, wide display type, mono labels, one red-pink accent. Single committed look, taken from solar-ess.org. */
:root{--navy:#0A1230;--navy2:#111c47;--blue:#2563EB;--sky:#DCE6FD;--paper:#FAFCFF;--white:#fff;--ink:#0A0E2E;--mute:#3E548E;--line:#DEE3ED;--hot:#5B5BD6;
--display:"Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;--thai:"IBM Plex Sans Thai","Inter Tight",sans-serif;color-scheme:light}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--display);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:20px}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hot);margin:0 0 14px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);text-wrap:balance;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1{font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,84px);line-height:1.02;font-weight:800}
h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,54px);line-height:1.06;font-weight:700}
h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:700}
p{margin:0}
.lede{font-size:18px;max-width:60ch;opacity:.85}
.btn{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;padding:14px 22px;border:1.5px solid var(--hot);background:var(--hot);color:var(--white);cursor:pointer}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:currentColor;color:inherit}
.btn:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}
/* nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:9;background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-block:10px}
.nav img{height:44px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--white);padding:2px}
.nav nav{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.nav nav a{text-decoration:none;opacity:.8}.nav nav a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--hot)}
/* dropdown sub-menus */
.nav nav .dd{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.nav nav .dd>a::after{content:"\25BE";margin-left:5px;font-size:.9em}
.nav nav .ddm{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:-14px;z-index:20;min-width:190px;padding:14px 14px 12px;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;background:var(--navy);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.nav nav .dd.end .ddm{left:auto;right:-14px}
.nav nav .dd:hover .ddm,.nav nav .dd:focus-within .ddm{display:flex}
@media(hover:none),(max-width:760px){.nav nav .dd{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.nav nav .dd>a::after{content:none}.nav nav .ddm{display:flex;position:static;flex-direction:row;min-width:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;gap:12px}.nav nav .ddm a::before{content:"\00B7  "}}
/* bands */
.band{padding-block:84px}
.dark{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white)}
.light{background:var(--white)}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-block:72px 0}
.hero .cells{position:absolute;inset:auto -10% -30% -10%;height:70%;transform:perspective(900px) rotateX(62deg);transform-origin:bottom;
 background:linear-gradient(rgba(10,18,48,0) 0%,rgba(10,18,48,.0) 40%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(220,230,253,.22) 0 2px,transparent 2px 64px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(220,230,253,.22) 0 2px,transparent 2px 64px),linear-gradient(180deg,#13235e,#2563EB);opacity:.55}
.hero .sun{position:absolute;right:-120px;top:-120px;width:420px;height:420px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(91,91,214,.55),rgba(91,91,214,0) 68%)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative}
.hero .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);margin-top:64px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.stats div{background:rgba(10,18,48,.86);padding:22px 16px}
.stats b{display:block;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stats span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
/* services */
.svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;margin-top:44px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--navy)}
.svc article{padding:28px 24px 30px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0}
.svc article:nth-child(odd){border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc article:nth-child(even){padding-left:24px}
.svc .n{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--blue);font-size:13px}
.svc h3{margin:6px 0 8px}
.tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.tags span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:4px 8px;color:var(--mute)}
/* calculator */
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:40px;margin-top:40px;align-items:start}
.calc label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
.bill{font-size:64px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--hot);margin:14px 0 6px}
.range{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;opacity:.7}
.note{font-size:13px;opacity:.7;margin-top:16px;max-width:52ch}
.out{background:var(--navy2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:26px}
.out .big{font-size:52px;font-weight:800;color:var(--hot);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin:22px 0}
.kv b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kv span,.out small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
/* projects */
.proj{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:40px}
.proj article{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);padding:18px;min-height:190px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
.proj article::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(220,230,253,.09) 0 1px,transparent 1px 28px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(220,230,253,.09) 0 1px,transparent 1px 28px)}
.proj article>*{position:relative}
.proj .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;opacity:.7}
.proj .cap{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--sky)}
.proj h3{font-size:18px}
.proj .loc{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
/* voices */
.voices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px;margin-top:40px}
.voices figure{margin:0;border-top:1.5px solid var(--navy);padding-top:20px;min-width:0}
.voices blockquote{margin:10px 0 16px;font-size:17px}
.voices figcaption{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.mini div{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px;font-family:var(--thai);font-size:15px;min-width:0}
.mini b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px;font-weight:500}
/* about */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:48px;align-items:start}
.about p+p{margin-top:14px}
.brands{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.brands span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;border:1px solid var(--navy);padding:6px 10px}
/* faq */
details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
summary::after{content:"+";font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--hot);font-size:22px;line-height:1}
details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
details p{margin-top:10px;max-width:68ch;color:var(--mute)}
/* consult */
.consult{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:48px}
.ticks{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ticks li::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--hot);margin-right:12px}
form{display:grid;gap:14px}
form label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75;display:grid;gap:6px}
form input,form select,form textarea{font:inherit;color:var(--white);background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding:8px 0;border-radius:0}
form select option{color:var(--ink)}
#formmsg{font-size:14px;color:var(--sky)}
.contact{margin-top:28px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;user-select:all}
footer{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-block:36px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em}
footer .wrap{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;opacity:.8}
@media(max-width:820px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.svc,.calc,.voices,.about,.consult{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.svc article,.svc article:nth-child(even){padding:24px 0;border-right:0}.proj,.mini{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.band{padding-block:60px}.bill{font-size:48px}.out .big{font-size:40px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.proj,.mini{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.nav nav{margin-left:0;gap:12px}}
.dl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:28px;padding:16px 20px;max-width:560px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:var(--white);text-decoration:none}.dl:hover{border-color:var(--hot)}.dlicon{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:52px;background:var(--hot);color:var(--white)}.dltext{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.dltext b{font-size:18px}.dltext span{font-size:15px;opacity:.85}.dltext small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}.langsw{display:inline-flex;gap:10px;margin-left:14px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}.langsw a{opacity:.7}.langsw a[aria-current]{opacity:1;font-weight:700}[hidden]{display:none!important}@media(hover:hover) and (min-width:761px){.nav nav .ddm a{white-space:nowrap}}@media(hover:none),(max-width:760px){.nav nav .ddm{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:8px}}

.topicbar{position:sticky;top:var(--navh,72px);z-index:8;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:12px}
.topicbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.topicdd{position:relative}
.topicdd summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.topicdd summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.topicdd summary::after{content:"\25BE"}
.topicdd[open] summary::after{content:"\25B4"}
.topicdd .tmenu{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;z-index:30;min-width:280px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--navy);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:8px 0}
.topicdd .tmenu a{color:var(--white);padding:9px 16px;font-size:14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;text-decoration:none}
.topicdd .tmenu a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.topicdd .tmenu a span{opacity:.6;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px}
.topicchips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.topicchips a{font-size:13px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.topicchips a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.topicsec,#topic-top{scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--navh,72px) + 80px)}
.topicsec+.topicsec{margin-top:56px}
.topicsec>h2.th{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,38px);padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--blue);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}
.topicsec>h2.th small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mute);font-weight:400}
.topicsec .notes{margin-top:20px}
@media(max-width:700px){.topicchips{display:none}.topicbar{position:static}.topicsec,#topic-top{scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--navh,72px) + 12px)}}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:30;display:flex;gap:8px}.fab a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--hot,#5B5BD6);color:#fff;font:600 14px/1 var(--sans,system-ui),sans-serif;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(10,18,48,.3)}.fab svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor}@media print{.fab{display:none}}@media(max-width:380px){.fab a{padding:12px;font-size:0;gap:0}.fab svg{width:20px;height:20px}}
</style>
<style>
.faqnav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
.faqnav a{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:7px 11px}
.faqnav a:hover{border-color:var(--hot);color:var(--hot)}
.fsec{padding-block:52px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.fsec h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,38px)}
.fsec .sub{color:var(--mute);margin:6px 0 18px}
details .a{margin-top:10px;max-width:74ch;color:var(--ink)}
.a p{margin:6px 0;color:inherit;max-width:none}
.a .lead{font-weight:700}
.a h5{margin:12px 0 2px;font-size:15px;color:var(--blue)}
.a ul,.a ol{margin:6px 0;padding-left:22px}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
.a table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0}
.a th{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);text-align:left;padding:7px 9px}
.a td{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px 9px;vertical-align:top}
.tip{background:var(--sky);border-left:4px solid var(--hot);padding:8px 12px;margin:8px 0;font-size:14px}
</style>
<style>
.notes{display:grid;gap:28px;margin-top:8px}
.tnote{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;align-items:start;border-top:1.5px solid var(--navy);padding-top:28px}
.tnote img{width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);display:block;background:var(--white)}

@media(max-width:700px){.tnote{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.tnote img{max-width:220px}}
</style>
